entries.subject: DAMIT 232: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-232.txt. Model 232, version 2016-06-27, pole (333°, -31°), period 6.920509 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 175 ±21 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Hektor whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 28 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.907 at 462 nm, 1.075 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#2e2c29 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 2.5% geometric albedo JPL lists, from the reference JPL states as "EAR-A-5-DDR-ALBEDOS-V1.0:TRIAD". It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
